en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a portrait of a uniformed military bandmaster in the upper left, and a large military band posed in front of and on an ornate octagonal music pavilion/bandstand in a park. The structure is richly decorated with carved wood or cast-iron elements and flags on top. The captioning and labels are printed in red Hungarian text around the images.
